CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.reviewed_grade_import_capability()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select '{"protocol":"N90_REVIEWED_V1","version":1}'::jsonb;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.unified_student_grade_import_capability()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select rakeezx.reviewed_grade_import_capability() || '{"unifiedProtocol":"N90_UNIFIED_V1","unifiedVersion":1}'::jsonb;
$function$
